headline: Fire Team
title: Fire Team | Magmarex Infergon Flamerion | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Here is a Fire team for Aniimo. Magmarex and Infergon bring heavy fire damage, and Flamerion backs them up. For the fourth slot, one guide picks Scorchhowl for more damage, while another picks Glacy to heal. Fire is weak to Water, so keep that in mind when you plan your team. Which fourth Aniimo would you run? Comment below!
description: A Fire team for Aniimo built around Magmarex, Infergon and Flamerion, with Scorchhowl or Glacy as the fourth Aniimo.
joke: This team is so hot, it needs its own fan club.
